title: Room Lighting Designer with GLB Furniture
prompt:
Create a 3D interactive room lighting designer using Three.js. The scene contains loaded GLB furniture models and the user can place, move, and configure multiple light sources to see real-time illumination changes. The entire application must be in a single HTML file.

## Three.js Import
Use this importmap in <head>:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
Then in <script type="module">:
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';

## Scene Setup
- Background 0x1a1a2e.
- PerspectiveCamera at (8, 6, 8), looking at origin.
- OrbitControls enabled.
- Very dim ambient light (0x202030, intensity 0.1) — room should be mostly dark without placed lights.
- A room box: floor (15x15) at y=0 with texture from 'hardwood2_diffuse.jpg', 4 walls (height 5) with color 0xccccaa, ceiling at y=5 color 0xeeeeee. Walls and ceiling should receive shadows.
- Enable renderer shadow maps (PCFSoftShadowMap).

## Furniture (GLB Assets)
- Load 'Lantern.glb' using GLTFLoader, scale to fit ~0.8 units tall, place at (3, 0, 2). This is a decorative lantern.
- Load 'SheenChair.glb' using GLTFLoader, scale to fit ~1.2 units tall, place at (-3, 0, -2).
- Load 'coffeemat.glb' using GLTFLoader, scale to fit ~1.0 units, place at (0, 0, 0).
- All loaded models must cast and receive shadows.

## Light Sources
- The user can have up to 5 point lights in the scene.
- Default: 1 warm point light (0xffaa44, intensity 2.0) at position (0, 3, 0), castShadow=true.
- Each light has a visible sphere helper (radius 0.15) colored to match the light color.
- Each light also has a PointLightHelper.

## Controls
- Button (id='btn-add-light') to add a new light at a random position (x: -5..5, y: 1..4, z: -5..5). Disabled when 5 lights exist.
- Button (id='btn-remove-light') to remove the last added light.
- Slider (id='slider-intensity', range 0.1 to 5.0, step 0.1, default 2.0) to set the intensity of the currently selected light.
- Slider (id='slider-color-temp', range 2000 to 8000, step 100, default 4000) to set color temperature (2000=warm orange, 4000=neutral, 8000=cool blue). Map to RGB approximately.
- Slider (id='slider-height', range 0.5 to 4.5, step 0.1, default 3.0) to set the y-position of the selected light.
- Press '1'-'5' to select a light by index (if it exists).
- Press 'T' to toggle shadows on/off.

## HUD (id='hud')
- Light count (id='hud-lights'): current number of lights
- Selected light (id='hud-selected'): index of selected light (1-based) or 'None'
- Selected intensity (id='hud-intensity'): intensity of selected light, 1 decimal
- Shadow mode (id='hud-shadows'): 'ON' or 'OFF'
- Models loaded (id='hud-models'): count of loaded GLB models (target: 3)
- FPS (id='hud-fps'): frames per second, integer

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame:
- `lightCount`: number (0-5)
- `selectedLight`: number (0-based index, -1 if none)
- `selectedIntensity`: number (rounded to 1 decimal)
- `selectedHeight`: number (rounded to 1 decimal)
- `colorTemp`: number
- `shadowsEnabled`: boolean
- `modelsLoaded`: number (count of successfully loaded GLB models)
- `frameCount`: number
- `totalLightIntensity`: number (sum of all light intensities, rounded to 1 decimal)
- `lightsValid`: boolean (all light positions finite, no NaN)

Ensure the animation loop updates __3D_STATE__ every frame before rendering.
physics_constraints: Shadow maps must be enabled by default. All GLB models must load successfully. Light count must stay in [0, 5]. Light intensities must be positive. Color temperature mapping must produce valid RGB. No NaN in light positions.
